name: Limbus Company: Season 6 - Zàng Huā Yín
summary:
Season 6: Zàng Huā Yín, is the sixth Season of Limbus Company.

It consists of the game's eighth Story Chapter (Canto VIII: The Surrendered Witnessing) centered on Hong Lu from the literary source Dream of the Red Chamber, one side story event, and the sixth Mirror Dungeon, as well as the release of Identities based on story content and E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass. Additionally, the season contained the game's first limited-time event collaboration with the game Arknights, adding E.G.O based upon characters from the game.
